falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes above 4,800 on any single day within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The 2020 Dec breakout pattern requires failed resistance before continuation; an immediate breakout invalidates the analog and suggests a different regime (melt-up rather than consolidation-then-breakout)

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes below 12.00 for 3 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A blowoff score of 50 with sustained sub-12 VIX indicates complacency inconsistent with transition-phase volatility; this would signal the 'breakout' already occurred and we're in late-cycle euphoria, not the expected choppy transition

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops below 3.80% while S&P 500 simultaneously trades above 4,700
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: This combination breaks the correlation structure of the 2020 Dec pattern, which featured rising yields accompanying equity gains; it would indicate a deflationary/risk-off repricing rather than the reflationary breakout the pattern suggests

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
